messages:
sam_csm: Heads-up — Renewal for NorthArc hits next week. Procurement asked for invoice to go to 'NorthArc EU Ltd' (new billing entity). They already changed PO vendor code. We need to confirm Docusign signer and whether delegated e-sign will be OK since the CFO is OOO Mon-Wed.
ana_cs: Thanks. Do we have the updated vendor code+tax id? If so I can update the contract before sending to legal.
mike_legal: @ana_cs send me the proposed amendment PDF. Quick check: changing the billing entity might need legal signoff from both sides. If they want delegated signing (their procurement agent), we need Docusign routing + authority clause.
lisa_finance: Vendor code: VND-EU-9087, TaxID: GB999888777. PO number 45321-EU. We can accept invoice to NorthArc EU Ltd but require billing contact + VAT reg number on the invoice.
sam_csm: Attaching the email chain from the customer (copied into thread) and the current amendment we prepared. We also have an enablement kickoff scheduled next Wednesday — want to avoid hold.
john_sales: Customer insists on 9mo term instead of 12. Pricing is slightly higher for 9mo. Is that a blocker for procurement?
lisa_finance: 9mo term is fine. Need correct billing entity on contract. Pricing variance noted: 9mo prorated invoice total = $54,675. See snippet below:
```
Invoice summary:
- Term: 9 months
- Seats: 125
- Total (prorated): $54,675
- PO: 45321-EU
```
mike_legal: If we include delegated signer, add this to the signature block: "Authorized signatory delegated by CFO per written procurement authorization dated <date>". Also, include a short attestation checkbox on the Docusign envelope.
sam_csm: @docusign_bot can you create a draft envelope with the following routing: Primary signer = Procurement Agent (delegate) -> Secondary signer = Finance (LISA) -> DocuSign final audit signoff by legal? We want the attestation checkbox on page 2.
docusign_bot: Draft envelope created: envelope_id=env_78901. Routing set to: procurement_agent -> lisa_finance -> mike_legal. Checkbox placeholder added. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_78901
ana_cs: I reviewed the amendment. One change request: preserve the Dedicated capacity KMS clause (customer requires customer-managed keys). Does that impact signature or billing?
mike_legal: KMS clause is fine; just add the KMS key id line in section 4.2. Not a signatory issue.
john_sales: Confirmed with customer: procurement agent has delegated authority and will sign. CFO still wants final copy but won't be available until Thu. Customer happy with delegated sign.
sam_csm: Great. Next steps: 1) @ana_cs incorporate vendor code + KMS key + attestation text 2) @docusign_bot send envelope to procurement agent 3) @lisa_finance prepare invoice template with VAT fields 4) @mike_legal review final envelope before send. Target: send by today COB to hit onboarding kickoff.
lisa_finance: I'll create invoice draft and upload to the envelope once we have final contract PDF.
ana_cs: Updated the amendment and uploaded to envelope env_78901. Minor change: added clause "Billing entity change effective on signature date".
docusign_bot: Envelope env_78901 updated with document amendment_v3.pdf. Current status: ready_to_send.
mike_legal: Reviewing now. Small suggestion: replace "signature date" language with "execution date" for clarity.
sam_csm: @mike_legal please approve or leave comment in envelope. Time's tight.
mike_legal: Approved with the execution-date edit. Go ahead.
sam_csm: Sent envelope at 2024-05-11T17:03:12Z -> procurement agent.
docusign_bot: Signature event: procurement_agent signed at 2024-05-11T18:12:03Z. Next recipient: lisa_finance.
lisa_finance: Signed and uploaded invoice template with VAT reg.
docusign_bot: Signature event: lisa_finance signed at 2024-05-11T18:45:20Z. Final recipient: mike_legal.
mike_legal: Signed at 2024-05-11T19:05:01Z. Envelope completed. Final PDF available: https://docusign.example/env/env_78901/final.pdf
john_sales: Awesome — I notified the customer. They confirmed they uploaded proof of VAT registration to their procurement portal.
sam_csm: Marking renewal executed. I'll update the renewal tracker and kick onboarding enablement. Thanks everyone. :tada:
